data.name: Aamirah
data.gender_notes: Aamirah is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic word ‘amir, meaning commander or ruler. In Islamic tradition, Aamirah is a name for a female leader or a powerful woman. The name Aamirah carries the meaning “Commander of the people” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Aamirah usually hope their child will grow to embody commander of the people and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.etymology: Aamirah belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Commander of the people.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Aamirah total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.

in_urdu.name: امیرہ
in_urdu.long_meaning: امیرہ: امیروں کی بیٹی: یہ لقب ایک عورت کے لیے استعمال ہوتا ہے جو امیر خاندان سے تعلق رکھتی ہو، یا جس کے پاس عقل اور سمجھ کی بہتات ہو، اس کے علاوہ یہ لقب کبھی کبھار ایک عورت کو دکھایا جاتا ہے جو اپنے گھر والوں کے مقابلے میں بہت زیادہ ذہانت اور سمجھی رکھتی ہو

in_hindi.name: अमीरा
in_hindi.long_meaning: अमीरा:, अमीर की बेटी: यह नाम एक महिला के लिए उपयुक्त है, जो अमीर परिवार से संबंधित है या जो बुद्धिमत्ता और सामर्थ्य की विशेषता रखती है, इसके अलावा यह नाम कभी-कभी एक ऐसी महिला को ظाहिर किया जाता है जो अपने घरवालों के सामने बहुत अधिक बुद्धिमत्ता और सामर्थ्य रखती है
